theme_archetype.name: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Organic Emerald
theme_archetype.description: A high-trust, premium real estate and auction platform inspired by sahibinden.com. It relies on a structural grayscale base, utilizing Emerald Green (#24A86A) as the functional authority color. The Live Auction room employs a high-stakes Dark Mode variant with stark contrasting reds and greens to elevate emotional tension and urgency.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant. Sharp, authoritative headings paired with highly legible, geometric body text suitable for complex data tables and filtering.

heading.usage: H1 to H4, big numeric prices, and countdown timers.

body.usage: Paragraphs, lists, UI elements, labels, and dense data tables.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-extrabold
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy combined with The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboards and filters. Heavy use of p-6, p-8 for cards to prevent text collision. Mobile-first stacking.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 transition-all duration-200
buttons.danger_auction: bg-red-600 text-white font-bold rounded-md px-8 py-4 text-lg hover:bg-red-700 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)]

cards.property: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-xl hover:border-emerald-200 transition-all duration-300 group
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-100 p-6 shadow-sm

inputs.default: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors

header.nav: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 transition-all duration-300

images.description: Luxury modern house exterior, suitable for main landing page hero background
Lush farmland and green drone view, suitable for 'Parsel' and 'Arazi' sections
Business professionals handshake, for about us or trust/guarantee sections
Close-up of a wooden gavel, to be used in Live Auction room rules or entry screen

specific_page_patterns.homepage: Premium hero with backdrop-blur search bar. Stats dashboard overlay. Use generous white space. Trust badges below hero.
specific_page_patterns.listing_page: Left sidebar for filters (sticky). Right grid for cards. Cards must feature an image carousel. Map view toggle using Leaflet.
specific_page_patterns.detail_page: Bento-style property info. Large hero gallery. Sticky sidebar for price and 'Contact/Bid' action. 3D or Leaflet map integration prominently displayed.
specific_page_patterns.auction_room: Force dark mode (#0B0F19 background). Dramatic Countdown timer in center. Live websocket feed on the right sidebar. Glowing red CTA for 'Place Bid'. Confetti animation on win.
specific_page_patterns.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (dark slate). Main area light gray. Use Recharts for analytics. Density: high. Shadcn tables with pagination.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The project uses JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files, NOT TypeScript (.tsx). DO NOT generate .ts or .tsx files.
Always use the provided Image URLs in this file. NEVER use generic placeholder domains (e.g., via.placeholder.com).
Ensure every page has a visible navigation bar with a solid/glassmorphic background to prevent text collision over hero images.
When building Shadcn components or custom UI, use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Use Lucide-React for all iconography as requested.
For the Live Auction page, implement a dark theme interface distinct from the rest of the application to simulate high stakes and urgency.
Install necessary packages for animations (framer-motion, lucide-react, etc.) using standard Yarn/Npm commands.
Ensure the hero image overlay is not darker than bg-black/50 to let the paid assets breathe.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications, specifically for live bid updates and filter changes.
